meta.title: MUEDvox — a vocal harmonizer that follows your key and chords
meta.description: MUEDvox: a vocal harmonizer plugin with up to four voices and a bass part, a register lever for each voice, and harmony that follows your key and chords.

hero.title: One vocal in, up to four voices out — each sung a different way.
hero.lead: Vocal harmonies that follow your key and chords. Feed MUEDvox a lead vocal. It writes up to four harmony voices and a bass part that stay in key and move with your chords.

items.title: It follows the key and the chords.
items.body: Set the key and scale, or send the chords as MIDI. The harmony parts are chosen from them, so the same melody note gets a different harmony when the chord underneath changes. It follows modulations, keeps parts moving smoothly from one chord to the next, and holds steady through short passing notes instead of chasing each one.

items.title: Each voice has its own register.
items.body: A lever on every voice sets how it is sung: whisper, falsetto, head, mix or chest. The harmonies stop sounding like one voice copied four times.

items.title: Built to sit in a mix.
items.body: Up to four voices plus a bass part, a doubler and a chorus, and a formant control for each voice. Check it the way you would any vocal: in the full mix.

modes.heading: Three modes

render.name: Render
render.use: The cleanest sound. It reads ahead before it sings, so it is 0.94 s late. In Pro Tools, commit the track. In other DAWs, freeze or bounce the track if it plays late.

track.name: Track
track.use: Close to Render with a third of the latency. You can mix with the plugin on the insert.

modes.note: Latency is the value the plugin reports to your DAW. The time from a chord change to the harmony changing is longer than that.

items.question: How much delay does it add?
items.answer: It depends on the mode. Render is 0.94 s, Track is 0.34 s and Live is 3 ms (the value the plugin reports to your DAW). Render reads ahead, so in Pro Tools you commit the track. To sing or play along, use Live.

items.question: Does it work on Windows?
items.answer: Windows: VST3. macOS: AU, VST3 and AAX.

items.question: Does it work in Pro Tools?
What do I need to give it?
items.answer: One mono lead vocal on the track it is inserted on, and the key — set by hand, or sent as MIDI chords. Without chords it works from the key and scale you set.

items.question: Does it turn my voice into someone else's?
items.answer: No. The harmony parts are made from your own recording.

items.question: Does it come with presets?
items.answer: Seven: Natural, Clean, Wide Stack, Stack + Bass, Vintage Chorus, Plate Duo and Wide Duo. A preset switches the harmony and the FX together. Choosing one does not change Key, Scale or Mode.

items.question: How do I get my license key?
items.answer: After you buy, you are emailed a download link and the steps to get your key. The key is in your buyer's portal at mued.jp: sign in with the email address you used at checkout (a code is sent to that address). Drag the license.key file onto the plugin, or use "Load license file…" or "Paste license key". The plugin does not go online to activate, and there is no background app.

items.question: What does the demo do?
items.answer: The demo never expires: every 45 seconds the harmony drops out for about 3 seconds (your lead keeps playing). Saving presets needs a license; sessions made in the demo open unchanged once you add one. Only saving from MUEDvox’s own preset menu needs a license; presets you save with your DAW work in the demo too.

items.question: Do you have sales?
items.answer: No. It is $69 from the start, so there is no sale to wait for. It is the same $69 whenever you buy (amounts shown in other currencies move with exchange rates).

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: FastSpring is the Merchant of Record and handles refunds under the MUED Refund Policy. Purchases are generally non-refundable once the license key has been delivered, except for a billing error or a confirmed technical problem that prevents use. If the plugin does not run on a supported system, write to support@mued.jp first.
